name: dsh-restart-anywhere
description: Restart dsh in place from the sidebar or an agent tool; every in-progress session is snapshotted before teardown and resumed after the restart, or a safe restart waits for running turns and cuts nobody off. Fork of dsh-restart-anywhere 0.1.7.
author: Johannes Tebbert <info@joblessjoe.com> (https://joblessjoe.com)

dshhub.summary: Restart dsh in place; every in-progress session is told it was interrupted and resumed after the restart.
